statistics: No new measured scores, forecasts or simulated quantitative results. Lines show proposed relationships, not estimated causality.

headline.zh: 把不断扩大的参与，转化为持续共同创造。
headline.en: Turn expanding participation into sustained co-creation.

question.zh: 怎样把生态观察转化为不同参与者可以共同推进、持续检验的行动？
question.en: How can ecosystem observations become shared actions whose progress can be examined over time?

intro.zh: 第一章以“持续共同创造及其公共价值”确立共同方向，2.1 从参与规模与地域分布展开观察，随后各章追踪贡献、影响、技术分工和模型复用。本章沿着这条线索，提出三项共同任务和九条行动建议：让更多人能够留下来，让开放成果得到持续维护，让实际使用与公共结果可以检验。
intro.en: Chapter 1 establishes sustained co-creation and its public value as the shared direction. Section 2.1 begins with participation and geography; subsequent chapters examine contribution, influence, technical roles and model reuse. This chapter brings that evidence into three shared tasks and nine actions: helping people stay involved, sustaining open assets, and examining actual use and public outcomes.

scope.zh: 本章综合前文证据提出行动方向，沿用各节的统计范围与时间窗口。建议的实施和成效，需要在具体项目与当地条件下持续检验。
scope.en: This chapter develops action directions from earlier evidence, preserving each section’s scope and period. Implementation and outcomes require continued examination in specific projects and local contexts.

title.zh: 支持持续参与与人才成长
title.en: Support sustained participation and talent development

body.zh: 把参与入口连接到真实任务、导师反馈和角色成长。跟踪同一批参与者能否持续贡献，让不同地区与不同贡献角色都有机会进入共同维护和决策。
body.en: Connect real tasks, mentoring and role progression. Follow participant cohorts over time; open maintenance and decisions to people across regions and roles.

watch.zh: 后续参与、角色成长、跨地区合作
watch.en: Continued participation, role development and cross-region collaboration

title.zh: 建设可维护、可复用的开放技术基础

body.zh: 沿实际依赖确认维护责任，把文档、测试、评测、适配和人员接续纳入支持。清楚记录版本与上游关系，让后续创造能够复核条件、反馈改进。
body.en: Verify dependencies and maintenance owners. Support documentation, evaluation, adaptation and succession; record versions and upstream relationships for further use.

watch.zh: 维护责任、持续支持、可核验的复用
watch.en: Maintenance ownership, sustained support and verifiable reuse

title.zh: 推进透明治理与可验证的公共价值
title.en: Advance transparent governance and verifiable public value

body.zh: 公开参与规则、重要决策和责任安排；分别核查开放交付、实际采用与使用结果。让本地使用者参与问题定义和评价，逐步积累可验证的公共价值证据。
body.en: Publish rules, decisions and responsibilities. Examine delivery, use and outcomes separately, involving local users in defining needs and evaluating public value.

watch.zh: 开放材料、治理记录、公共使用与结果
watch.en: Open materials, governance records, public use and outcomes

title.zh: 生态地图：参与与平台覆盖

summary.zh: 2.1 展示多中心参与基础，也说明平台覆盖影响规模判断。由地区分布走向长期共建，需要追踪持续贡献、角色成长和参与机会。
summary.en: Section 2.1 shows multiple centres of participation and the effect of platform coverage. Connecting geography to lasting collaboration requires tracking continued contribution, role progression and opportunities to participate.

boundary.zh: 五域与 GitHub 国家统计分别解释；国内补充量不重复叠加。
boundary.en: Interpret five-group and GitHub country statistics separately; do not add the domestic supplement twice.

summary.zh: 第三章将地区、企业、基金会、项目与模型放回协作网络。参与规模与影响位次并非同一件事，榜单可以帮助定位需要进一步了解的主体。
summary.en: Chapter 3 places regions, companies, foundations, projects and models in their collaboration networks. Participation scale and influence rank differ; rankings help locate actors for further investigation.

boundary.zh: 榜次不能直接决定资助优先级，也不能代替维护需求和治理质量的核查。
boundary.en: Rank alone cannot determine funding priority or establish maintenance needs and governance quality.

summary.zh: 4.1 将 Agent Infra 与 Model Infra 中的项目放入功能分类，再观察类别和项目的月度变化。应用入口之外，运行、评估与基础工具也需要持续建设。
summary.en: Section 4.1 classifies projects across Agent Infra and Model Infra and observes monthly changes. Runtime, evaluation and foundational tools require continued development alongside application entry points.

boundary.zh: 分类位置不是已验证的依赖关系；其他领域目前主要提供全景与研究框架。
boundary.en: Classification does not establish dependencies. Other fields currently provide landscapes and research frameworks.

title.zh: 模型生态：供给、复用与开放

summary.zh: 5.1 观察供给扩张，5.2 追踪声明复用关系，5.3 区分材料完整性与许可开放性。600 个高开放性样本中，117 个同时具备高完整性。
summary.en: Section 5.1 examines supply, 5.2 declared reuse, and 5.3 completeness and licence openness. Of 600 highly open models in the sample, 117 also have high completeness.

boundary.zh: 供给为同一快照回溯；复用为声明关系；开放样本不能代替实际成效。
boundary.en: Supply is reconstructed from one snapshot; reuse is declared; openness does not establish outcomes.

role.zh: 提供长期支持与共同规则
role.en: Provide sustained support and shared rules

diagram.zh: 把公共支持，接到持续协作上
diagram.en: Connect public support to sustained collaboration

intro.zh: 公共部门和国际组织能够改善长期协作的条件。2.1 提醒资源配置同时关注已有中心、不断扩大的参与力量与平台覆盖；第三、四章为寻找共建对象提供线索。公共支持应进一步核查真实需求，把维护、人才成长和公共结果分别纳入安排。图 6-2-1 展示三条建议的实施路径。
intro.en: Public bodies and international organizations can improve conditions for lasting collaboration. Section 2.1 highlights established centres, expanding participation and platform coverage; Chapters 3 and 4 help locate potential partners. Public support should verify needs and address maintenance, participant growth and public outcomes. Figure 6-2-1 presents the three action pathways.

role.zh: 把使用、发布与维护接起来

diagram.zh: 让产品使用，带动开放基础的维护
diagram.en: Connect product use to maintenance of open foundations

intro.zh: 企业同时连接产品使用、开放发布与上游维护。第三章提供组织参与的观察，第四、五章展示技术分工与复用关系。建议把这些联系落实到研发预算、责任人员和版本记录，使维护与协作成为日常工作。图 6-3-1 将产品责任、开放发布和协作者成长放在同一流程中。
intro.en: Companies connect product use, open releases and upstream maintenance. Chapter 3 examines organizational participation; Chapters 4 and 5 add technical roles and reuse. These connections should inform engineering budgets, responsible teams and version records. Figure 6-3-1 links product responsibilities, open releases and contributor development.

role.zh: 开放参与路径，组织共同维护
role.en: Open participation paths and share maintenance

diagram.zh: 从一次加入，走向长期共同建设
diagram.en: From a first contribution to lasting co-creation

intro.zh: 全球合作的基础，是不同地区的人能够围绕共同问题持续工作。2.1 显示全球南方已具有值得关注的参与规模，区域节点也为连接更多伙伴提供了入口。社区可以进一步开放任务、评审与治理机会，让本地需求进入技术建设。图 6-4-1 将加入社区、联合维护与共同评价连接起来。
intro.en: Global cooperation rests on people in different regions working together on shared problems over time. Section 2.1 shows substantial participation in the Global South and opportunities to connect partners through regional nodes. Communities can open tasks, review and governance to wider participation and bring local needs into development. Figure 6-4-1 connects entry, joint maintenance and shared evaluation.

title.zh: 让公共支持延伸到长期维护
title.en: Extend public support to long-term maintenance

why.zh: 第三、四章帮助定位协作主体和技术环节；确定支持顺序，还需核查实际依赖、维护负担和已有资源。
why.en: Chapters 3 and 4 help locate actors and technical roles. Setting support priorities also requires evidence of actual dependencies, maintenance burdens and existing resources.

body.zh: 由公共资助方联合基金会、使用单位和维护团队，建立有明确范围的重点项目清单。支持日常维护、文档、测试、适配和安全修复，约定责任人、支持周期与人员交接；将成果的持续可用性纳入后续复盘。成熟基础项目与新生社区可采用不同方式，让资源安排与维护任务相匹配。
body.en: Public funders, foundations, users and maintainers should establish a scoped list of priority projects. Support maintenance, documentation, testing, adaptation and security fixes, with named owners, funding periods and succession arrangements. Review continued usability. Mature infrastructure and emerging communities may require different support arrangements.

body.zh: 从真实使用和维护记录出发，确认项目边界与支持缺口。
body.en: Use actual usage and maintenance records to identify project boundaries and support gaps.

body.zh: 明确维护事项、责任团队、支持周期与交接安排。
body.en: Specify maintenance work, accountable teams, support periods and handovers.

body.zh: 结合工作负担与使用反馈，继续、调整或平稳结束支持。
body.en: Use workload and user feedback to continue, adjust or wind down support.

detail.zh: 重点依赖是否有维护人和交接安排
detail.en: Named maintainers and handover plans for priority dependencies

detail.zh: 已确认资源与实际维护需求是否匹配
detail.en: Confirmed resources compared with actual maintenance needs

detail.zh: 同一范围内的问题响应、版本更新和使用反馈
detail.en: Responses, releases and user feedback within a consistent scope

title.zh: 把人才支持连接到真实共建任务
title.en: Connect talent support to real shared work

why.zh: 2.1 的多中心格局和区域实例提供了合作入口。参与规模反映基础，人才支持还需观察同一批人能否持续贡献、逐步承担责任。
why.en: Section 2.1’s multiple centres and regional examples identify opportunities for collaboration. Scale describes the participation base; talent support should also follow the same people as they contribute and take responsibility.

body.zh: 由地区、高校、企业与社区依托已有项目开放真实任务，配套导师、工具和持续反馈，认可文档、翻译、评测等多种贡献。国际组织可连接全球南方与其他地区的伙伴，支持远程、多语种和异步协作，并让本地伙伴参与任务设计。固定参与批次与观察周期，记录持续贡献、角色变化及退出原因，用于改进支持条件。
body.en: Regions, universities, companies and communities should open real tasks in existing projects, with mentoring, tools and continued feedback across documentation, translation and evaluation roles. International organizations can connect Global South partners with peers, support remote, multilingual and asynchronous work, and involve local partners in task design. Follow defined cohorts and periods, recording continued contributions, role changes and reasons for leaving.

body.zh: 把教学与合作需求放到可参与的项目中。
body.en: Connect teaching and partnership needs to accessible projects.

body.zh: 安排导师、文档、工具与多语言协作。
body.en: Provide mentors, documentation, tools and multilingual collaboration.

body.zh: 固定参与批次，记录持续贡献、角色变化和退出原因。
body.en: Follow defined cohorts: continued contributions, role changes and reasons for leaving.

work.zh: 连接区域节点与全球南方伙伴
work.en: Connect regional nodes and Global South partners

detail.zh: 同一批首次参与者的后续活动
detail.en: Follow-up activity of the same first-time participant cohort

detail.zh: 从首次任务到评审和维护的路径
detail.en: Paths from first tasks to review and maintenance

detail.zh: 跨地区共同任务与持续维护记录
detail.en: Cross-region tasks and continued maintenance records

title.zh: 把开放交付与公共结果分开验收
title.en: Review open deliverables and public outcomes separately

why.zh: 第一章区分目标、指标和证据，5.3 进一步区分材料完整性与许可开放性。公共支持需要把这些条件连接到实际使用和结果。
why.en: Chapter 1 distinguishes goals, indicators and evidence; section 5.3 separates completeness from licence openness. Public support should connect these conditions to actual use and outcomes.

body.zh: 公共资助与应用试点可分别约定开放材料、维护安排和预期回应的公共需求。交付按具体版本核对材料与许可，使用按部署、服务对象和运行周期记录，结果由本地实施方、目标使用者与研究者共同评价。国际合作可共享记录格式和复核方法；正式认可依据相应规则单独核验，使不同层次的证据各有对应。
body.en: Public funding and pilots can specify open materials, maintenance and the public needs to address. Check delivery by version, record use by deployment, user group and operating period, and evaluate outcomes with local implementers, intended users and researchers. International cooperation can share documentation and review methods. Verify formal recognition under its applicable rules, keeping the evidence for each layer distinct.

body.zh: 由实施方与目标使用者共同确定问题和观察范围。
body.en: Implementers and intended users jointly define the problem and observation scope.

body.zh: 逐项保存开放材料、许可说明、维护与变更记录。
body.en: Record open materials, license information, maintenance and changes item by item.

body.zh: 公开具体部署与结果材料，说明适用范围和未知项。
body.en: Document actual deployment and outcomes, including scope and unknowns.

detail.zh: 适用材料、已检查项和未知项分别记录
detail.en: Record applicable materials, checked items and unknowns separately

detail.zh: 具体部署、使用对象和持续运维记录
detail.en: Deployment, intended users and continued operation records

detail.zh: 有明确方法与时间范围的结果材料
detail.en: Outcome evidence with methods and time periods

title.zh: 把上游维护纳入产品责任
title.en: Make upstream maintenance part of product responsibility

why.zh: 第四章的技术分工和 5.2 的复用网络提示，产品与模型往往建立在已有成果之上。采用关系需要进一步落实为维护责任和改进回流。
why.en: Chapter 4’s technical roles and section 5.2’s reuse networks show how products and models build on earlier assets. Adoption relationships should be connected to maintenance responsibilities and returning improvements.

body.zh: 研发与产品团队共同核对关键代码、模型和数据的版本及上游，标记已确认与待核查的依赖。为关键依赖安排对接人员和工作时间，将修复、测试、适配和文档改进提交上游，并分别记录提交、讨论与接纳状态。产品调整或人员变动时，保留维护、迁移与交接安排，使责任跨越单次发布。
body.en: Engineering and product teams should verify versions and upstream sources for key code, models and data, distinguishing confirmed dependencies from those needing review. Assign contacts and working time; return fixes, tests, adaptations and documentation, separately recording submission, discussion and acceptance. Preserve maintenance, migration and handover arrangements through product and personnel changes.

body.zh: 核对版本、上游来源及依赖它们的产品。
body.en: Verify versions, upstream sources and dependent products.

body.zh: 明确责任团队，把修复与适配回馈上游。
body.en: Assign accountable teams and return fixes and adaptations upstream.

body.zh: 结合使用问题与上游反馈，调整投入与交接。
body.en: Use product issues and upstream feedback to refine support and handovers.

detail.zh: 关键依赖中已明确责任人与计划的范围
detail.en: Critical dependencies with named owners and plans

detail.zh: 已提交、已讨论与已接纳的改进分别记录
detail.en: Distinguish submitted, discussed and accepted improvements

detail.zh: 人员变化后的维护与迁移安排
detail.en: Maintenance and migration plans after staffing changes

title.zh: 让每次发布清晰、可用、可追溯
title.en: Make every release clear, usable and traceable

why.zh: 5.3 的样本差异说明，较开放的许可条件仍需完整材料配合。清晰发布能让下游判断如何运行、复核和继续改进。
why.en: Section 5.3’s sample shows that open licence conditions still need complete materials. Clear releases help downstream users determine how to run, examine and improve an asset.

body.zh: 以具体版本为单位组织代码、权重、数据说明、评测条件、许可与上游声明，分别标明已提供、待核实和不适用项。运行示例同时说明环境、资源需求和已知局限，并提供维护入口。发布后根据复核与使用反馈更新档案，让材料、许可和变更记录保持对应；涉及公共应用时，另行积累实际使用与结果证据。
body.en: Organize code, weights, data documentation, evaluation conditions, licences and upstream declarations by version, marking provided, unverified and inapplicable items separately. Document the environment, resource needs, limitations and maintenance access alongside runnable examples. Update the dossier through review and user feedback, keeping materials, licences and changes aligned. Public applications also require evidence of use and outcomes.

body.zh: 把代码、模型、数据说明与上游信息对应起来。
body.en: Connect code, models, data descriptions and upstream information.

body.zh: 同时发布运行示例、条件说明与问题反馈渠道。
body.en: Publish runnable examples, usage conditions and a feedback channel.

body.zh: 记录版本变化、已知局限与下游使用反馈。
body.en: Track version changes, known limitations and downstream feedback.

work.en: Check materials and report adaptation issues

detail.zh: 同一版本的材料和许可是否相互对应
detail.en: Whether materials and licenses match the same version

detail.zh: 在声明环境中完成复核的运行记录
detail.en: Reproduction records in the stated environment

detail.zh: 更新日期、已知局限与问题处理记录
detail.en: Update dates, known limits and issue handling

title.zh: 为协作者成长提供时间与认可
title.en: Give contributors time and recognition to grow

why.zh: 2.1 提出从参与基础走向长期共建，第三章则提供企业参与结构的观察。组织投入需要落实到协作者的时间、反馈和成长机会。
why.en: Section 2.1 moves from participation towards lasting collaboration, while Chapter 3 examines corporate participation. Organizational support should provide contributors with time, feedback and opportunities to grow.

body.zh: 将上游参与、外部贡献评审与文档维护纳入研发计划，明确责任团队和可用时间。认可代码之外的测试、翻译、支持和发布工作，为高校、中小团队与个人贡献者提供稳定对接。评价结合贡献内容、协作质量与持续责任，跟踪同一批协作者的角色成长，使投入与真实共建相连接。
body.en: Include upstream work, external review and documentation in engineering plans, with responsible teams and allocated time. Recognize testing, translation, support and release work, and provide stable contacts for universities, small teams and individuals. Assess contribution content, collaboration quality and sustained responsibility, following role progression within the same contributor cohorts.

body.zh: 把上游参与、外部评审与文档维护放入工作计划。
body.en: Plan for upstream work, external review and documentation.

body.zh: 让代码、测试、翻译与支持贡献得到认可。
body.en: Recognize code, testing, translation and support contributions.

body.zh: 支持贡献者逐步承担评审、发布与维护责任。
body.en: Help contributors progress into review, release and maintenance roles.

detail.zh: 同一批参与者的后续贡献与维护活动
detail.en: Subsequent contributions and maintenance by the same cohort

detail.zh: 代码之外的工作是否有记录和认可
detail.en: Whether work beyond code is recorded and recognized

detail.zh: 外部问题、评审与维护合作能否延续
detail.en: Whether external feedback, review and maintenance relationships persist

title.zh: 让新人走向共同维护者
title.en: Create paths from newcomers to co-maintainers

why.zh: 2.1 的增长与地域分布说明参与来源在扩展。让这些力量留下来，需要容易找到的任务、持续反馈和清楚的角色成长规则。
why.en: Section 2.1’s growth and geography show expanding sources of participation. Keeping people involved requires discoverable tasks, continued feedback and clear routes to greater responsibility.

body.zh: 从边界清楚的首次任务开始，配套多语种文档、异步沟通和导师支持，公开贡献评审与维护者接续规则。将代码、文档、翻译和用户支持纳入成长路径，让不同背景的贡献者逐步进入评审与决策。结合项目节奏跟踪固定参与批次，例如参与后三个月、六个月的变化，同时记录退出原因，持续改进入口和协作条件。
body.en: Start with clearly scoped first tasks, multilingual documentation, asynchronous communication and mentoring. Publish review and maintainer succession rules. Include code, documentation, translation and user support in progression paths. Track defined cohorts at project-appropriate intervals, such as three and six months after joining, and record reasons for leaving to improve entry and collaboration conditions.

body.zh: 任务边界清楚，文档和求助入口易于找到。
body.en: Make task scope, documentation and help channels clear.

body.zh: 导师与协作者共同给出反馈，认可不同贡献。
body.en: Mentors and collaborators provide feedback and recognize varied contributions.

body.zh: 公开角色成长与交接规则，减少对少数人的依赖。
body.en: Publish progression and handover practices to reduce dependence on a few people.

work.en: Complete tasks and grow into responsibility

detail.zh: 任务、文档和求助是否能够被实际找到
detail.en: Whether tasks, documentation and help can be found in practice

detail.zh: 固定参与批次的后续贡献与退出原因
detail.en: Follow-up contributions and departure reasons for fixed cohorts

detail.zh: 新贡献者进入评审和维护的真实记录
detail.en: Records of newcomers entering review and maintenance

title.zh: 围绕共同依赖组织跨地区维护
title.en: Organize cross-region maintenance around shared dependencies

why.zh: 2.1 为寻找跨地区伙伴提供参与线索，第四、五章为辨识共同技术任务提供入口。合作应进一步核实真实依赖、共同需求和持续分工。
why.en: Section 2.1 helps identify regional partners, while Chapters 4 and 5 help identify shared technical work. Cooperation should establish actual dependencies, common needs and lasting responsibilities.

body.zh: 沿上游与下游关系，由维护者和本地使用方共同选择兼容、适配、评测或文档任务，约定交付、评审与后续维护。为资源较少地区和全球南方伙伴提供参与条件，使其能够共同定义任务和重要决策。保留版本、贡献与改进回流记录，定期检查合作能否跨越人员变化和单次活动。
body.en: Along upstream and downstream relationships, maintainers and local users can jointly select compatibility, adaptation, evaluation or documentation tasks, agreeing delivery, review and continued maintenance. Enable partners in less-resourced regions and the Global South to shape tasks and important decisions. Retain version, contribution and upstream-feedback records, and review whether cooperation lasts beyond events and personnel changes.

body.zh: 沿真实依赖和复用关系联系维护者与使用方。
body.en: Contact maintainers and users through verified dependencies and reuse.

body.zh: 共同确定适配、评测和维护任务，让本地伙伴参与决策。
body.en: Agree adaptation, evaluation and maintenance tasks, involving local partners in decisions.

body.zh: 让改进回到上游，保留版本和接续维护记录。
body.en: Return improvements upstream and retain version and maintenance records.

work.zh: 说明基础能力与维护需求

detail.zh: 有明确对象、分工和交付的联合工作
detail.en: Joint work with defined objects, roles and deliverables

detail.zh: 向上游反馈、讨论和接纳的具体记录
detail.en: Specific upstream feedback, discussion and acceptance records

detail.zh: 跨版本、跨人员变化后的合作持续性
detail.en: Collaboration across versions and staffing changes

title.zh: 让公共需求进入共同设计与治理
title.en: Bring public needs into shared design and governance

why.zh: 第一章将公共价值作为共同方向，前文各类指标提供了不同层次的观察。具体成果是否回应需求，需要使用者、实施者与维护者共同检验。
why.en: Chapter 1 establishes public value as a shared direction; earlier indicators offer different layers of observation. Users, implementers and maintainers should jointly examine whether a specific asset addresses a need.

body.zh: 从明确的本地需求出发，邀请目标使用者参与问题定义、试用与结果评价。社区公开重要决策、反馈处理和维护责任，记录实际参与者、使用范围、受益情况及局限。将适配经验和评价反馈带回上游，形成可以继续改进的版本与工作安排，使一次公共应用与后续共同创造相衔接。
body.en: Start with a specific local need and involve intended users in defining the problem, testing and evaluation. Publish important decisions, feedback handling and maintenance responsibilities; record participation, scope of use, benefits and limitations. Return adaptation experience and evaluation feedback upstream, connecting public applications to further versions and shared work.

body.zh: 让本地伙伴与使用者参与需求和评价设计。
body.en: Involve local partners and users in needs and evaluation design.

body.zh: 记录适配工作、重要决策与维护责任。
body.en: Record adaptations, important decisions and maintenance responsibilities.

body.zh: 复核真实使用与结果，把改进用于下一轮创造。
body.en: Examine use and outcomes, then carry improvements into the next cycle.

detail.zh: 需求、设计与决策中的实际参与者
detail.en: Actual participants in needs, design and decisions

detail.zh: 有明确范围的真实使用与受益记录
detail.en: Real use and benefit records within a defined scope

detail.zh: 本地反馈如何进入上游版本和后续维护
detail.en: How local feedback enters upstream releases and maintenance

question.zh: 怎样把参与基础的增长，转化为可以延续的协作与公共价值？
question.en: How can growing participation support lasting collaboration and public value?

paragraphs.zh: 前五章逐步展开了同一个问题：谁能够参与，形成了什么贡献，哪些主体和技术环节连接这些工作，开放成果又怎样支持后续创造。综合来看，参与入口、维护责任和使用条件需要同时建设。规模、位次与开放程度各自提供线索，持续共同创造则需要沿着人、成果和使用过程继续追踪。
paragraphs.en: The first five chapters examine who can participate, what they contribute, which actors and technical roles connect that work, and how open assets support further creation. Together, they point to the need to develop participation pathways, maintenance responsibilities and conditions for use. Scale, rank and openness each offer evidence; sustained co-creation requires following people, assets and their use over time.

after.zh: 以下九条建议分别说明为何行动、由谁推进和怎样复盘。实施时先确定对象、起点和观察周期，再记录投入、过程与结果。相同范围内的后续变化有助于改进支持；跨地区比较则应同时保留平台、样本和时间窗口的差异。
after.en: The nine recommendations explain why to act, who should take responsibility and how to review progress. Begin with a defined population, baseline and observation period, then record inputs, processes and outcomes. Follow-up within a comparable scope can improve support; comparisons across regions should retain differences in platforms, samples and time periods.

title.zh: 6.1.1 参与呈现多中心格局，长期协作需要继续培育
title.en: 6.1.1 Multiple centres of participation need lasting collaboration

paragraphs.zh: 2.1 显示，2026 报告年度 GitHub 全球活跃开发者约 2,890.36 万；印度、巴西和印度尼西亚合计约占 18.2%。按编制组五域统计，美国、欧洲和中国的开发者总量均接近 3,000 万。两组观察分别说明，已有中心与不断扩大的参与力量共同构成了全球共建基础。
paragraphs.en: Section 2.1 records about 28.9036 million active GitHub developers in the 2026 reporting year, with India, Brazil and Indonesia together accounting for about 18.2%. In the editorial team’s five-group statistics, the United States, Europe and China each approach 30 million developers in total. These distinct observations show both established centres and expanding sources of participation.

paragraphs.zh: 平台覆盖也影响哪些参与能够被看见。2.1 在国家比较中单列国内平台补充量，五域综合统计则保持自身范围。这提示后续研究完善跨平台覆盖与去重；行动上，应以区域节点、真实任务和导师支持连接更多参与者，尤其让全球南方伙伴进入共同维护与决策。规模增长是否延续为长期贡献，还需跟踪同一批参与者的后续活动。
paragraphs.en: Platform coverage affects whose participation is visible. Section 2.1 reports the domestic-platform supplement separately in country comparisons while retaining the scope of its five-group series. Research should improve coverage and deduplication. Action should connect participants through regional nodes, real tasks and mentoring, including Global South partners in maintenance and decisions. Following the same participant cohorts is necessary to assess whether growth develops into lasting contribution.

title.zh: 6.1.2 用影响力定位主体，用技术分工识别共建任务
title.en: 6.1.2 Locate actors through influence and shared work through technical roles

paragraphs.zh: 第三章把地区、企业、基金会和项目放入协作网络，帮助寻找具有连接作用的主体。第四章进一步解释项目在技术体系中承担什么功能：4.1 对 Agent Infra 与 Model Infra 的分类和月度观察，连接了应用入口与运行、评估、工具链等基础能力；4.2—4.6 的全景则为其他领域建立了后续研究入口。
paragraphs.en: Chapter 3 locates regions, companies, foundations and projects within collaboration networks. Chapter 4 adds their technical roles: section 4.1 connects application entry points with runtime, evaluation and tooling through its Agent Infra and Model Infra categories and monthly observations. The landscapes in sections 4.2–4.6 provide entry points for further research in other fields.

paragraphs.zh: 由此提出的行动重点，是沿实际使用关系确认共同依赖，再核查维护团队、工作负担和支持缺口。榜单可以帮助选择调查对象，分类可以帮助辨识分工；资源配置仍需具体的依赖、维护与使用证据。头部项目和规模较小的基础组件，都可能需要跨组织共同承担长期工作。
paragraphs.en: The resulting action priority is to establish shared dependencies from actual use, then examine maintainers, workload and support gaps. Rankings can identify subjects for investigation and categories can clarify technical roles. Resource allocation still requires concrete evidence of dependencies, maintenance and use. Both leading projects and smaller foundational components may need sustained work across organizations.

title.zh: 6.1.3 供给与复用扩展，开放条件仍需落实到具体版本
title.en: 6.1.3 Growing supply and reuse require version-specific openness

paragraphs.zh: 第五章将供给、复用与开放条件连在一起。5.1 的同一快照回溯中，模型数量增长 58.3%，发布账号增长 48.4%；5.2 进一步展示声明关系中的派生网络与影响力结构。供给增加扩大了选择范围，后续创造是否便利，还取决于上游关系、版本材料和使用条件能否查清。
paragraphs.en: Chapter 5 connects supply, reuse and openness. In section 5.1’s reconstruction from a single snapshot, model counts grow by 58.3% and publishing accounts by 48.4%. Section 5.2 examines declared derivation networks and influence. Greater supply widens choice; further creation also depends on clear upstream relationships, versioned materials and conditions of use.

paragraphs.zh: 5.3 的 870 个模型样本中，600 个被归为高开放性，其中 117 个同时具备高完整性；其余 483 个仍有材料完整性缺口。这个差异提示，许可条件需要与代码、权重、数据说明、评测和维护入口相互配合。该样本支持完善发布和复核流程；实际采用、正式认可与公共成效，还应分别取得证据。
paragraphs.en: Among the 870 models examined in section 5.3, 600 are classified as highly open, of which 117 also have high completeness; the remaining 483 have completeness gaps. This difference points to the need to connect licence conditions with code, weights, data documentation, evaluation and maintenance access. The sample supports improving release and review processes. Actual adoption, formal recognition and public outcomes each require their own evidence.

task_title.zh: 6.1.4 三项共同任务，贯穿不同主体与领域
task_title.en: 6.1.4 Three shared tasks across actors and fields

figure_lead.zh: 图 6-1-1 将上述观察连接到第一章提出的三项共同任务。任务贯穿四大支柱，各主体承担不同职责，并通过共同维护、开放交付与使用反馈相互衔接。
figure_lead.en: Figure 6-1-1 connects these observations to the three shared tasks introduced in Chapter 1. The tasks span the four pillars; actors take distinct responsibilities linked through maintenance, open delivery and feedback from use.

body.zh: 任务、工具、导师与多语言协作提供参与条件。观察同一批参与者能否继续贡献，并逐步承担新的责任。
body.en: Tasks, tools, mentors and multilingual collaboration support participation. Observe whether the same cohort continues contributing and takes on new responsibilities.

body.zh: 代码、评审、文档、翻译、测试与支持共同构成协作。贡献记录帮助看见工作，责任分工帮助工作持续。
body.en: Code, reviews, documentation, translation, tests and support all contribute to collaboration. Records make work visible; shared responsibilities help it continue.

body.zh: 代码、模型与数据需要清晰的版本、材料、许可和维护入口。开放条件使后续使用者能够判断怎样采用与继续改进。
body.en: Code, models and data need clear versions, materials, licenses and maintenance contacts. Openness conditions help downstream users understand how to adopt and improve them.

subtitle.zh: 让一次发布连接下一次创造
subtitle.en: Connect one release to the next creation

body.zh: 采用、适配与派生把已有成果带入新的任务。保留上游关系与具体版本，让使用经验和改进有机会回到共同基础。
body.en: Adoption, adaptation and derivation bring assets into new tasks. Retaining upstream relationships and versions creates a path for experience and improvements to return to shared foundations.

subtitle.zh: 让真实使用与结果可验证

body.zh: 从公共需求进入具体应用，再观察实际受益与局限。由本地使用者、实施者和研究者共同提供证据，帮助下一轮改进。
body.en: Start with public needs and concrete applications, then examine benefits and limits. Local users, implementers and researchers can provide evidence for the next round of improvements.

subtitle.zh: 让经验与资源回到共建
subtitle.en: Return learning and resources to collaboration

body.zh: 根据维护需要与真实结果，调整资源、规则和参与机会。把支持延伸到日常维护、人员接续与新的公共需求，开启下一轮共同创造。
body.en: Use maintenance needs and actual outcomes to refine resources, rules and participation opportunities. Support routine maintenance, succession and new public needs to enable the next cycle of co-creation.

label.en: Return to the three shared tasks

title.zh: 结语：迈向可持续的数字未来

question.zh: 怎样让这份报告，也成为持续共同创造的一部分？
question.en: How can this report itself become part of sustained co-creation?

paragraphs.zh: 未来展望应落实为可以持续追踪的问题：参与能否延续为贡献，贡献能否支撑维护，开放成果能否进入真实使用，使用经验又能否改进下一轮共同工作。图 6-5-1 表达这种反馈关系。每个环节都需要责任主体与记录，过程中的停顿和退出也应成为改进依据。
paragraphs.en: The outlook should become a set of questions that can be followed over time: does participation develop into contribution, does contribution sustain maintenance, are open assets used, and does that experience improve subsequent work? Figure 6-5-1 expresses this feedback relationship. Each stage needs responsible actors and records, including interruptions and departures that can inform improvement.

paragraphs.zh: 行动可以从有明确对象的共同项目开始。先由参与方确认需求、起点和责任，再记录投入、交付与使用过程，在约定周期共同复盘。复盘关注哪些参与得以延续、哪些维护问题得到回应、哪些使用结果已有证据，并据此决定继续、调整或平稳结束支持。观察项应随项目成熟度选择，不要求所有地区和领域采用同一阈值。
paragraphs.en: Action can begin with a clearly scoped joint project. Agree needs, a baseline and responsibilities, record inputs, delivery and use, and review together at agreed intervals. Examine continued participation, maintenance issues addressed and evidenced outcomes, then decide whether to continue, adapt or conclude support. Choose observations appropriate to project maturity rather than imposing a common threshold across regions and fields.

paragraphs.zh: 下一轮研究应优先补齐三条证据链。参与方面，延续 2.1 的跨平台覆盖与地域观察，逐步连接固定批次的贡献和角色记录；成果方面，核对组织、项目、模型、版本及上下游关系，将技术分类接到可核查的维护与采用；公共价值方面，结合真实应用记录参与、受益和局限。未知、未检查与模拟内容继续保留明确状态，以新增证据逐步完善。
paragraphs.en: The next research cycle should strengthen three evidence chains. For participation, extend section 2.1’s platform and geographic coverage and connect it to cohort-level contributions and roles. For assets, verify organizations, projects, models, versions and upstream relationships, linking technical categories to documented maintenance and adoption. For public value, record participation, benefits and limitations in actual applications. Keep unknown, unchecked and simulated elements clearly identified as evidence improves.

paragraphs.zh: 这也使报告本身成为共同工作的组成部分。政府与国际组织改善支持条件，企业连接使用与维护，社区和本地伙伴开放参与与治理，研究者持续核对变化与解释边界。把这些工作接起来，开放成果才能更有机会跨越一次发布、一个项目和一个年度，成为下一次创造的基础。
paragraphs.en: This makes the report part of shared work. Governments and international organizations improve support conditions; companies connect use and maintenance; communities and local partners open participation and governance; researchers verify change and its interpretation. Together, these efforts help open assets endure beyond a release, project or reporting year and support further creation.

final.zh: 我们最终关注的，是更多人能够持续参与，让共同创造的成果得到维护、复用与发展，并使其公共价值得到解释、验证和延续。
final.en: Our ultimate concern is that more people can remain involved, that shared creations can be maintained, reused and developed, and that their public value can be explained, examined and sustained.

invitation.zh: 持续共同创造及其公共价值
invitation.en: Sustained co-creation and its public value

position.zh: 本章回到 OSDGs 的四大支柱，将人才、开放供给、全球连接、治理与公共价值落实到共同工作。OSDI 的二十九项指标提供观察框架；以下跟踪项用于组织行动复盘，不另行合成总分。
position.en: This chapter returns to the four OSDGs pillars, connecting people, open supply, global connections, governance and public value to shared work. The 29 OSDI indicators provide an observation framework; the follow-up items below support reviews of action rather than an additional composite score.
